title: Identify European Firaga compact cell source
changes: Document a source-rooted compact cell directory, ten frame streams and a ten-entry sequence, preserving unknown fields and excluding the intervening bytes.
Track publication, wider consumer coverage and deferred platform checks in the ROM data recovery checklist.
validation: Static source plan e309-firaga-compact-source-plan-163iufku authenticates 626 plus 22 sampled source bytes, reader fingerprints, ten compact frame extents and E251 non-overlap.
Wine disassembly e309-firaga-compact-readers-wine-wv43bxaa and constructor/count evidence m654jv6l, 5bhu4sna and artnj9cx support the reader interpretation; Wine servers drained.
limitations: The scene sample lacks executing PCs; source fields, wider selectors and scenes remain partially unclassified. No resource is published by this source-only plan.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance comparison was made.
